name: Pelham PVMP Summer Camp
description_short: Town run day camp at Pelham Veterans Memorial Park for Pelham children from age 6 through grade 8, weekdays 9:30 to 3:30 for six weeks. Campers are grouped by age with an assigned counselor, and each group has an optional paid field trip most weeks.
refund_policy_summary: Cancellations before camp starts are refunded less a handling charge; no refunds after camp starts, and no refunds or make up days for rain closures.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page; 2026 camp for Pelham residents only, ages 6 to 8th grade, July 6 to August 14, 9:30 to 3:30; first child $215 for 1 week, $415 for any 3 weeks, $625 for 6 weeks; additional children $170, $315, $475; extended care 7:30 to 9:30 and 3:30 to 5:30 at $2 per 30 minutes

Researched by Claude from this page; 2026 general information sheet: camp at 109 Veterans Memorial Way (PVMP/Town Beach), camp phone 603-635-2721, age groups with assigned counselors, optional field trips at extra cost, scholarship form on request

warnings: Open to Pelham residents only, so there is no non-resident rate to list.
Age 14 only if entering 8th grade in fall 2026.
Prices shown are for the first child; each additional child in a family pays less ($170 a week, $475 for 6 weeks).
Camp closes on steady rain days with no make up days.
unknowns: swim details (the camp is at the town beach)
